_readme: Allowed send/call/connect windows per market, enforced by compliance.operating_hours_ok(). Times are local to the listed IANA timezone. US is a single default window (Eastern) as a conservative placeholder — TODO: segment by state/timezone once real US target list geography is known, since TCPA call-time rules are evaluated at the *recipient's* local time, not HQ time.

UK.notes: UK PECR restricts unsolicited live/automated calls; cold calling to numbers registered on the Telephone Preference Service (TPS) is prohibited absent a documented exemption.

US.notes: TODO: TCPA requires call-time compliance (8am-9pm) evaluated at the CALLED PARTY's local time zone, not this default. Do not rely on this single window once prospects span multiple US time zones.

AU.notes: Australia's Do Not Call Register and Spam Act 2003 apply; calls also restricted on national public holidays (not modeled here yet).
